snippet.title: CASSETTE BOY Steam Release Date Announcement Trailer - Pocketpair Publishing
snippet.description:
🖤Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334330/CASSETTE_BOY


"If I'm not looking, does the moon still shine above?"

Pocketpair Publishing is proud to present CASSETTE BOY, a puzzle action RPG created by a solo dev from Japan!

Rotate the map to change your perspective. Anything hidden from view "ceases to exist." Use this mechanic to challenge the world's mysteries!

Try the Demo on Steam and Wishlist NOW!

■Game Overview
Title: CASSETTE BOY
Genre: Puzzle Action RPG
Release Date: January 15, 2026
Developer: Wonderland Kazakiri inc.
Publisher: Pocketpair Publishing

●About Pocketpair Publishing
Pocketpair Publishing provides comprehensive support for indie game developers and small studios through funding, development assistance, and publishing.

For inquiries or questions, please contact Pocketpair Publishing via the Pocketpair Publishing inquiry form on the official Pocketpair website.

▼Pocketpair Publishing Inquiry Form
https://www.pocketpair.jp/publishing

#CASSETTEBOY #pocketpair
